Would you like to join an international, purpose-driven organisation and contribute to the continuity of its financial operations during the summer period? We are currently looking for a Temporary Finance Assistant to support the team throughout August and ensure the smooth running of ongoing financial activities.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Follow up on sales invoices and credit notes (invoice creation handled via CRM) 
 
• Ensure accurate monitoring and maintenance of the accounts receivable (aged balance) 
 
• Prepare documentation for foreign VAT declarations 
 
• Support financial reporting for external tax consultants 
 
• Contribute to the smooth execution of daily financial operations 
 
• Collaborate with internal teams and external partners in an international environment 

 
 
• Degree in accounting or finance (e.g. EPHEC or equivalent) 
 
• Initial experience in finance/accounting is an asset 
 
• Fast learner with a proactive mindset 
 
• Good command of English (spoken and written) 
 
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365 
 
• Knowledge of Dynamics and/or Business Central is a strong plus 
 
• Previous experience with ESTRO is an advantage 
 
• Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and reliability

What does the role involve?
 

 
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
 
• You precisely measure materials.
 
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
 
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key. 

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
 
• Good spatial awareness.
 
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
 
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
 
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

Are you a driven Category CE/C driver who enjoys being behind the wheel and likes variety in your job? 

Then this Category CE/C driver position might be just right for you. 

For a stable and growing company in the transport sector in Turnhout, we are looking for an enthusiastic Category CE/C driver who is willing to carry out national routes. 

What will you do? 
 
 

• As a Category C or C driver, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium. 

• You play a crucial role in daily operations and ensure that customers receive their deliveries correctly and on time. 

• You deliver goods to customers safely and punctually 

• You load and unload your truck according to guidelines. 

• You check the goods and accompanying documents 

• You have direct contact with customers and act as the company's ambassador 

• You handle your planning with flexibility 

What do we expect from you?
 
 

• You hold a valid Category CE or C driving licence and a valid Code 95 . 

• You have a good knowledge of English 

• You are customer-oriented and professional 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility 

• You are physically fit and enjoy active work.

Our customer is an international organisation who specialises in the packaging of machine parts with a focus on efficiency and excellence. Their Core Values are flexibility, quality, speed and discretion.

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented, reliable, and looking for a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment? Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you!

 

We’re looking for enthusiastic employees to do the packaging of a wide variety of machine parts in Lokeren. As a Packaging Employee, you'll make sure our products are packed with care and precision, ready to be delivered to customers worldwide. For this job, you will use a scanning system and a computer to ensure everything is registered correctly.

Who are we looking for?

• Comfortable standing for long periods without discomfort.
• Available for long-term work, full-time from monday to friday.
• Lifting weights up to 10 kg is not a problem (no physical issues).
• Able to communicate in English and/or Dutch
• Experience as a packaging employee is a plus.

What does the role involve?
 

 
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
 
• You precisely measure materials.
 
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
 
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key. 

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.

• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
 
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!

• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.

• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.

• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.

• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.

• You have a very good knowledge of English.

You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
 

 
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
 
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner
 
• Assisting with filling the tunnels
 
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn
 
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!) 

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
 

 
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner
 
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)
 
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently
 
• You speak Dutch, French or English

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

The 
Product Manager will lead and manage the product line using a market-based approach. This role will develop and manipulate the product line plans globally for the division. This role also encompasses end-to-end product line ownership including product and market strategy deployment, product roadmap development, and overall product line management.
 

The ideal candidate should:
 
 

• Possess strong skills in conducting business and market assessments, evaluating business strategies and demonstrating excellent communication abilities to effectively develop and present their recommendations among Sales, Finance, Product Marketing and Communications. 

• Demonstrate fluency in stage-gate product development processes, pricing strategy, and cross-functional product commercialization.  

Key domains:
 

Portfolio & product lifecycle management and innovation.
 

Market intelligence & competitive strategy.
 

Business cases & financial accountability.
 

Go-to-market strategy & sales enablement.
 

Customer & market development.

 

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in product management, product marketing or commercial management. 

• Experience in packaging, specialty chemicals or other manufacturing industry required. 

• Experience working across multiple regions or global organizations is preferred. 

• Bachelor’s degree is required - Master is preferred. 

• Ability to travel up to 50%. 

• Strong analytical and qualitative assessment skills. 

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Dutch | English | French). 

• Acute attention to detail with ability to assess at macro level. 

• Demonstrate initiative, integrity and results-oriented mindset. 

• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment. 

• Demonstrated ability to develop and defend strategy, build product roadmaps, and present investment recommendations to senior leadership. 

• Strong financial acumen including profit management, cost structure analysis, and business case development. 

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word. 

• Experience with ERP systems, CRM platforms, and project management tools, preferred.

Our client is looking for a dedicated operator to join their dynamic team in Pittem.

As an  operator, you will be responsible for the entire carrot processing process within your line.

You will ensure that the installation runs optimally and continuously monitor the quality and efficiency.

Your tasks will include:

• Checking incoming carrots and correctly storing them in the bunkers
• Operating, monitoring, and adjusting the machines responsible for the entire peeling process
• Continuously monitoring the production process and intervening where necessary
• Taking responsibility for the process until the grated carrots arrive in the production hall, where the further process is taken over by the team
The company cuts and packages fresh vegetables in an innovative way and produces creative ready-to-eat meal salads for the retail and food service sector. 

• A strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail
• Technically minded and able to monitor and adjust machines
• Fluent in English
• Experience as an operator or in a production environment is a plus

A highly reliable partner for our customers around the world, we offer environmentally friendly products that increase the comfort of homes and buildings in terms of insulation, safety, acoustics and air quality.

Remuneration: 17.5605 / h   shiftnumération : 2 shifts: 1.2497 /h   4.5 euro meal vouchers per day worked.

As an operator in the recycling department, you and your colleagues will be responsible for the following tasks:

- supply and removal of materials by forklift truck

- filling the goods

- cleaning the production lines

 

You have had technical training or already have experience working within production.

You can work on a regular 2 shifts: 6h-14h, 14h-22h or fix night shift 22h-6h

You communicate in English

You can work with a PC.

You can work with a forklift truck. A certificate can be obtained through us.

Safe and clean work is important to you

Our client is a globally recognized technology and engineering company that develops innovative solutions for the food, pharmaceutical, and process industries. As a Senior Automation Software Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering advanced automation projects that drive efficiency, digitalization, and sustainability.

• Take ownership of all software-related activities within complex automation projects.

• Develop, implement, test, install, and maintain industrial software solutions in line with quality and validation standards.

• Prepare software validation documentation while ensuring projects are delivered efficiently in terms of cost, quality, and timing.

• Act as the technical point of contact for internal teams and external stakeholders regarding software-related matters.

• Contribute to innovative technologies that help optimize production processes and support a more sustainable future.

Our client is looking for an experienced automation professional who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Software Engineering, or equivalent through experience.

• Minimum 10+ years of experience in automation and industrial software development.

• Strong knowledge of TIA Portal, SCL, STL, LAD, and SQL.

• Experience with Schneider Drives is considered a strong asset.

• Knowledge of .NET is a valuable plus.

• Fluent in English; Dutch language skills are an advantage.

• Willing to work 3 days per week on-site in the Halle or Wommelgem area.

• Strong communication skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to work independently on complex projects.

ISS Governance is seeking a talented Corporate Governance Research Analyst to join its Custom team. The Custom Research team partners with clients to fully optimize their corporate governance program through the provision of governance expertise as well as customized deliverables. Custom Research Analysts, working as members of regional teams, help clients develop and/or implement customized guidelines that reflect the clients' unique corporate governance philosophy. Using Policy Engine, a data-driven automation tool for base policy automation, in conjunction with analyst expertise on the subject of corporate governance, the Custom Research team provides clients with customized vote recommendations based on their respective proxy voting guidelines.  

 

As part of providing end-to-end management of client policies, the team keeps clients apprised of new trends and emerging proposals that have garnered increased interest in the investment community and assists clients in developing and implementing policies on these new issues. To this end, the team provides clients with tailored reports, including an annual custom policy matrix that captures voting instructions and procedures on proxy issues that are expected to be seen on ballots in the upcoming year, and policy gap analyses to identify areas in client policy that do not effectively address any particular corporate governance issue. 

 

Responsibilities 

• Issue insightful, grounded, well-reasoned proxy vote recommendations and rationale based on client-specific proxy voting guidelines for institutional investors based in Continental Europe 
• Experience in gathering corporate governance data based on information in the company's public documents 
• Experience in actively work with institutional investors to help them updating, developing, or formulating their proxy voting guidelines 
• Complete various client-specific projects 
• Research policy-related issues, and support teammates in their completion of client projects as needed 
• Contribute to seasonal reviews, client calls, and client-focused research reports 
• Experience in engagement with institutional investors and other market players  
• Answer internal and external queries on research analyses, and discuss policies and vote recommendations as appropriate 
• Participate in and actively contribute to ISS Governance policy formulation and update efforts  
• Work with Corporate Technology to develop, enhance, and test current and new applications that will benefit our clients, the department, and the company as a whole 
• Work closely with Sales and Account Management counterparts to ensure overall positive client experience  
 

 
 
Qualifications. 

• Master's degree in Law and/or Finance, Economics/Politics or equivalent through experience  
• Previous experience in the proxy voting industry working with institutional investors is a plus   
• Strong computer literacy with previous experience and excellent knowledge of MS Office 
• Strong analytical abilities and comfort with ambiguity 
• Excellent problem solving and judgment skills 
• Excellent English writing and oral communication skills, and the ability to formulate and support a position on an issue.  
• Organizational skills, attention to detail, a self-driven work ethic, and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment 
• Ability to work within a team-oriented environment and communicate with various internal and external parties 
• Willingness to work long hours and weekends primarily during peak weeks (March, April, May, June), but on an as-needed basis throughout the year as well 
• Good understanding of business technology, and experience working with technology in an operational context

We are looking for an electromechanic for a company located in Kortenberg. The company provides roadside assistance services for trucks. 

Your tasks:

 

 
• You conduct diagnostics on trucks and airport vehicles. 
 

 
• You troubleshoot and resolve electrical issues. 
 
• You use diagnostic systems to analyze problems. 
 
• You repair mechanical issues. 

You have experience as an electromechanic.

You have at least 3 to 4 years of experience working on trucks as an electromechanic.

You can work with a computer to diagnose issues.

You are proficient in English or French or Dutch

Experience with Bosch KTS diagnostic testers or Jaltest diagnose is an advantage

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this tailor-made for each customer. Since its inception in 2003, the company has grown step by step and continues to do so. By 2027 the company is aiming for 300+ employees working together on 25 000 unique packaging assignments.

Working in this company means working in a respectful environment where great bonding between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

We are looking for a motivated production worker with mechanical insight to join our team.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 
• 
Setting up and adjusting various packaging machines

 
• 
Monitoring and checking different packaging lines

 
• 
Intervening and troubleshooting minor technical issues when needed (mechanical)

 
• 
Providing general support in the production environment

 
• 
Carrying out small practical tasks, such as hanging signs and other light maintenance jobs

 
• 
You have a basic understanding of mechanics 

 
• 
You are practical, hands-on, and solution-oriented

 
• 
Experience in a packaging environment is an advantage

 
• 
You speak English (Dutch and/or French are a plus)

 
• 
You are available to work during daytime shifts on a daily basis

 
• 
You work accurately and can function independently

For a company in the Waregem region, we are looking for an all-round (multi-skilled) employee. You will work in a company that processes second-hand clothing.

What does the job involve?

• You assist with the initial sorting process (on top of the sorting installation).
• You are responsible for removing and transporting the initially sorted items.
• You assist our drivers with manual unloading.

• Dynamic
• Good physical condition
• Insightful, able to work independently
• No dust allergy
• Forklift experience + certificate = a plus
• You speak French / English or Dutch fluently

We are looking for an additional production worker within the cladding department.

Salary: 17.912 euro bruto / hour + 1.2497 euro bruto/ hour extra shiftpremie or 4.16556 euro bruto/ hour in de fix night + 4.5 euro mealvouchers per day.

Duties:

- You are responsible for inserting and removing the profiles in the machine.

- You assist the operator in a smooth start-up of the production line and support him/her when the process needs to be adjusted.

- Together with the operator you monitor the continuity and quality of the process and follow up on the operator's instructions.

You have had your first experience in production.

You can hold an interview in English.

You can work in 2 shifts or nightshift

jobs.occupation: B2B Growth & Account Management | 100% Remote | FR - NL
jobs.description:
As part of the launch and expansion of a fast-growing European company in Belgium, you will play a key role in driving business growth and establishing a strong presence in the Belgian market.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

As a leading provider of business financing solutions, we help companies accelerate their growth through flexible and innovative funding options. Following our success in other European markets, we are now expanding our operations in Belgium and building our local presence.

Omschrijving

Your Responsibilities

• Build and develop the company's commercial footprint across Belgium.
• Identify, prospect, and acquire new B2B clients through a proactive hunting approach.
• Create, enrich, and manage a qualified database of prospects and decision-makers.
• Develop long-term relationships with key stakeholders and strategic partners.
• Contribute to the local growth strategy and provide regular market insights and reporting.
• Represent the company at networking events, trade fairs, and industry conferences.
• Support the future development and structuring of the Belgian business operations.
Your Profile

• Perfectly bilingual in French and Dutch (mandatory), with a good command of English.
• Minimum 3-4 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, or a similar commercial role.
• Strong prospecting, negotiation, and client acquisition skills.
• Independent, energetic, and ambitious, with a proactive mindset.
• Thrives in a challenging environment and is motivated by achieving results.
• Entrepreneurial spirit with the ability to build opportunities from scratch.
